leaderboard_description: Competitive ratings, one scale per speed. Training estimates are separate and appear on player profiles.
leaderboard_history_scope: Published snapshots currently cover bots only. They preserve the ratings and records at their stated cutoff.
leaderboard_history_empty: No published snapshots for this speed yet.
leaderboard_history_unsupported: Published history is not available on this server yet.
leaderboard_history_error: Published history is unavailable right now. Try again.
leaderboard_snapshot_error: This snapshot could not be loaded. Choose another snapshot or retry.
leaderboard_snapshot_missing: This published snapshot is no longer available at the requested address.
leaderboard_snapshot_saved: Saved snapshot. Later games do not change these numbers.
leaderboard_live_error: The leaderboard is unavailable right now — try again in a minute.
leaderboard_disabled: Ratings are unavailable in this build.
leaderboard_empty: Nothing on the {speed} board yet — a rating appears once it has settled at this speed.
leaderboard_order_help: Places follow the ordering score supplied by the server. For Glicko-2 this is rating − 2 × RD, a conservative estimate; a higher rating alone does not guarantee a higher place.
leaderboard_caption: Competitive ratings in the server's published order
leaderboard_snapshot_empty: This snapshot has no eligible participants.
leaderboard_compare_warning: Compare only the same speed, rating domain and epoch. A historical rating is not a current estimate.
leaderboard_invalid_link: This snapshot link is incomplete or invalid. Choose a speed to browse published history.
